- 手工 observation、属性传播和 trace input/output：<https://langfuse.com/docs/observability/sdk/instrumentation>
- Agent trace 的结构与命名实践：<https://langfuse.com/docs/observability/best-practices>
- 观察类型（agent、generation、tool 等）：<https://langfuse.com/docs/observability/features/observation-types>
- Dataset / SDK experiments：<https://langfuse.com/docs/evaluation/experiments/experiments-via-sdk>
- Code evaluator 与 observation/experiment 范围：<https://langfuse.com/docs/evaluation/evaluation-methods/code-evaluators>

class RepositoryTag:

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IndexedFile:

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RepositoryScanLimits:
    max_files: int = 8_000
    max_file_bytes: int = 1_000_000
    max_total_bytes: int = 32_000_000
    max_scan_ms: int = 60_000

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if min(self.max_files, self.max_file_bytes, self.max_total_bytes, self.max_scan_ms) < 1:
            raise ValueError("repository scan limits must be positive")

    def __init__(self, config: RepositoryExplorerConfig) -> None:
        self._config = config
        self._cache = RepositoryTagCache(
            config.cache_dir, max_entries=config.cache_max_entries, ttl_ms=config.cache_ttl_ms
        )
        try:
            import importlib.util

            if (
                importlib.util.find_spec("tree_sitter") is None
                or importlib.util.find_spec("tree_sitter_python") is None
            ):
                raise ImportError("tree_sitter or tree_sitter_python is not installed")
            from tree_sitter import Language, Parser, Query, QueryCursor
        except ImportError as error:  # composition checks before constructing in production
            raise RepositoryIndexError("repository_explorer requires the repository-explorer extra") from error
        self._parser, self._query, self._cursor = Parser, Query, QueryCursor
        self._languages: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for language_name, (module_name, factory_name) in self._GRAMMAR_MODULES.items():
            try:
                module = import_module(module_name)
                factory = getattr(module, factory_name)
                self._languages[language_name] = Language(factory())
            except (AttributeError, ImportError, TypeError):
                continue
        if "python" not in self._languages:
            raise RepositoryIndexError("repository_explorer requires the repository-explorer extra")

    async def index(self, include_tests: bool) -> tuple[IndexedFile, ...]:
        return await asyncio.to_thread(self._index_sync, include_tests)

    def _index_sync(self, include_tests: bool) -> tuple[IndexedFile, ...]:
        started = _now_ms()
        indexed: list[IndexedFile] = []
        total_bytes = 0
        for path in self._discover(include_tests, started):
            stat = path.stat()
            relative = path.relative_to(self._config.workspace_root).as_posix()
            total_bytes += stat.st_size
            if total_bytes > self._config.limits.max_total_bytes:
                raise RepositoryScanLimitExceeded("repository_scan_limit_exceeded: total_bytes")
            cached = self._cache.lookup(relative, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns)
            if cached is not None:
                indexed.append(cached)
                continue
            raw = path.read_bytes()
            if b"\0" in raw[:8192]:
                indexed_file = IndexedFile(relative, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), (), False)
            else:
                indexed_file = IndexedFile(relative, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), self._tags(relative, raw), True)
            self._cache.store(indexed_file, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns)
            indexed.append(indexed_file)
        return tuple(indexed)

    def _discover(self, include_tests: bool, started: int) -> Iterable[Path]:
        root = self._config.workspace_root
        stack = [root]
        found = 0
        while stack:
            if _now_ms() - started > self._config.limits.max_scan_ms:
                raise RepositoryScanLimitExceeded("repository_scan_limit_exceeded: scan_time")
            directory = stack.pop()
            for child in sorted(directory.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name, reverse=True):
                try:
                    resolved = child.resolve(strict=True)
                    resolved.relative_to(root)
                    stat = resolved.stat()
                except (OSError, ValueError):
                    continue
                relative = resolved.relative_to(root).as_posix()
                if resolved.is_dir():
                    if child.name not in _DEFAULT_SKIPPED_DIRS and resolved != self._config.cache_dir:
                        stack.append(resolved)
                    continue
                if not resolved.is_file() or stat.st_size > self._config.limits.max_file_bytes:
                    continue
                if not include_tests and _is_test_path(relative):
                    continue
                found += 1
                if found > self._config.limits.max_files:
                    raise RepositoryScanLimitExceeded("repository_scan_limit_exceeded: files")
                yield resolved

    def _tags(self, relative_path: str, raw: bytes) -> tuple[RepositoryTag, ...]:
        language_name = self._LANGUAGE_BY_SUFFIX.get(Path(relative_path).suffix.lower())
        if language_name is None:
            return ()
        return self._tree_sitter_tags(relative_path, raw, language_name)

    def _tree_sitter_tags(self, relative_path: str, raw: bytes, language_name: str) -> tuple[RepositoryTag, ...]:
        """Run wheel-shipped capture queries over a tree-sitter syntax tree."""
        language = self._languages.get(language_name)
        if language is None:
            return ()
        try:
            parser = self._parser(language)
            root_node = parser.parse(raw).root_node
        except Exception:
            return ()
        tags: list[RepositoryTag] = []
        # The Python bindings expose native query/cursor objects. Keep every
        # object alive until its captures have been consumed: some supported
        # tree-sitter builds otherwise release a query while its cursor still
        # owns native capture buffers.
        native_objects: list[object] = []
        for source in _query_source(language_name).split("\n\n"):
            try:
                query = self._query(language, source)
                cursor = self._cursor(query)
                native_objects.extend((query, cursor))
                captures = cursor.captures(root_node)
            except Exception:
                continue
            names = captures.get("name", [])
            for capture, nodes in captures.items():
                if capture.startswith("definition."):
                    role: TagRole | None = "definition"
                elif capture.startswith("reference."):
                    role = "reference"
                else:
                    role = None
                if role is None:
                    continue
                kind = _symbol_kind(capture.removeprefix(f"{role}."))
                for node in nodes:
                    for name in names:
                        if node.start_byte <= name.start_byte and name.end_byte <= node.end_byte:
                            decoded = raw[name.start_byte : name.end_byte].decode("utf-8", "replace")
                            tags.append(RepositoryTag(relative_path, decoded, role, kind, name.start_point.row + 1))
        unique = {
            (tag.relative_path, tag.name, tag.role, tag.symbol_kind, tag.line, tag.low_confidence): tag for tag in tags
        }
        return tuple(sorted(unique.values(), key=lambda tag: (tag.line, tag.name, tag.role)))

"""A dataset item, run by the real Agent and scored from what it committed.

``run_case`` is the whole point of the evaluation harness: the Agent under test
is the one a deployment serves — the same Session, Drive, tools and settlement
path — and every number a scorer reads is a fact the Drive published *after*
``Session.mutate`` returned.  What is asserted here is what an experiment
therefore rests on: the workspace a run is confined to, the tools a case is
actually offered, and the agreement between the trace an observer sees and the
result that gets scored.
"""

import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

    EVALUATORS,
    CaseError,
    EvalCase,
    Expectations,
    RunOutput,
    run_case,
)
from agent_harness.runtime.generation import AssistantResult, GenerationRequest, ToolCall
from agent_harness.runtime.telemetry import GenerationTelemetry, OperationTelemetry, ToolTelemetry
from agent_harness.storage.memory import MemoryStorage
from agent_harness.storage.sqlite import SQLiteStorage

FIXTURE = "the readme says: a durable agent runtime."
ANSWER = "The readme describes a durable agent runtime."
SECRET = "not for the agent to read"

_CASE = EvalCase(
    id="readme-summary",
    prompt="summarise the readme",
    files={"README.md": FIXTURE},
    expectations=Expectations(required_tools=("read",), answer_contract={"contains": ["durable agent runtime"]}),
)


class ScriptedProvider:
    """Reads the fixture once, then answers — the shape of a real turn.

    Keyed by session so a single provider can serve every item of a dataset.
    """

    model = "scripted"

    def __init__(self, *, path: str | None = "README.md", answer: str = ANSWER) -> None:
        self._path = path
        self._answer = answer
        self.requests: list[GenerationRequest] = []
        self._turns: dict[str, int] = {}

    async def generate(self, request: GenerationRequest) -> AssistantResult:
        self.requests.append(request)
        turn = self._turns.get(request.session_id, 0) + 1
        self._turns[request.session_id] = turn
        if turn == 1 and self._path is not None:
            return AssistantResult(
                content="",
                usage={"prompt_tokens": 30, "completion_tokens": 5},
                tool_calls=(ToolCall(f"call-{turn}", "read", {"path": self._path}),),
            )
        return AssistantResult(content=self._answer, usage={"prompt_tokens": 20, "completion_tokens": 7})


class Collector:
    """A sink that keeps every fact the Drive published."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.events: list = []

    def record(self, event) -> None:
        self.events.append(event)

    def of(self, kind) -> list:
        return [event for event in self.events if isinstance(event, kind)]


def _score(name: str, output: RunOutput, expected: dict) -> float:
    evaluation = EVALUATORS[name](output=output, expected_output=expected)
    assert evaluation is not None, f"{name} declined to score"
    return evaluation.value


def test_a_case_runs_end_to_end_and_reports_what_it_committed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    workdir = tmp_path / "run"
    provider = ScriptedProvider()

    output = asyncio.run(run_case(_CASE, provider, workdir=workdir))

    assert output.answer == ANSWER
    assert (output.terminal_status, output.unknown_effects) == ("completed", 0)
    assert output.session_id == "eval:readme-summary"
    assert output.operation_id == "readme-summary-1"
    assert output.generation_count == 2
    # Usage is summed over the turn's committed generations, not taken from the
    # last one: a three-round turn costs what all three rounds cost.
    assert output.usage == {"prompt_tokens": 50, "completion_tokens": 12}
    assert [call.name for call in output.tool_calls] == ["read"]
    assert output.tool_calls[0].is_error is False
    assert output.duration_ms is not None and output.duration_ms >= 0

    # The fixture was written where the tools look for it...
    assert (workdir / "workspace" / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == FIXTURE
    # ...and the durable session lives beside the workspace, never inside it,
    # so no relative path from a tool can rewrite the Agent's own history.
    assert (workdir / "session.sqlite").exists()
    assert list((workdir / "workspace").glob("*.sqlite")) == []


def test_the_facts_that_are_uploaded_are_the_facts_that_are_scored(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    collector = Collector()
    provider = ScriptedProvider()

    output = asyncio.run(run_case(_CASE, provider, workdir=tmp_path / "run", telemetry=collector))

    started, terminal = collector.of(OperationTelemetry)

"""The evaluation CLI: what it runs, what it refuses, and what it reports.

Every test injects a provider, so nothing here reaches a model or Langfuse.
What is asserted is the contract an operator (and a CI gate) depends on: the
exit code, what reaches stdout and stderr, and the report file.

Exit codes are the interface: 0 scored, 1 a gate failed, 2 the run was refused
before it cost anything.  A refusal that still called the model would be worse
than useless, because the dataset's bug would be paid for on every run.
"""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import eval_harness
import pytest

from agent_harness.api.settings import Settings
from agent_harness.integrations.evaluation import parse_case
from agent_harness.runtime.generation import AssistantResult, GenerationRequest, ToolCall

FIXTURE = "the readme says: a durable agent runtime."
ANSWER = "The readme describes a durable agent runtime."
API_KEY = "sk-secret-value-for-tests"
REPOSITORY_ID = "git@example.com:owner/repo.git"


class ScriptedProvider:
    """Answers each case the way the dataset expects, keyed by the prompt.

    One instance serves the whole dataset: an experiment runs its items
    concurrently, so a provider that counted calls globally would be wrong.
    """

    model = "scripted"

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.requests: list[GenerationRequest] = []
        self._turns: dict[str, int] = {}

    async def generate(self, request: GenerationRequest) -> AssistantResult:
        self.requests.append(request)
        prompt = str(request.messages[0]["content"])
        turn = self._turns.get(request.session_id, 0) + 1
        self._turns[request.session_id] = turn
        if turn == 1:
            path = "absent.md" if "missing" in prompt else "README.md"
            return AssistantResult(
                content="",
                usage={"prompt_tokens": 30, "completion_tokens": 5},
                tool_calls=(ToolCall(f"call-{turn}", "read", {"path": path}),),
            )
        answer = "there is no such file" if "missing" in prompt else ANSWER
        return AssistantResult(content=answer, usage={"prompt_tokens": 20, "completion_tokens": 7})


CASES = [
    {
        "input": {"prompt": "summarise the readme", "files": {"README.md": FIXTURE}, "tools": ["read"]},
        "expected_output": {"required_tools": ["read"], "answer_contract": {"contains": ["durable"]}},
        "metadata": {"id": "readme"},
    },
    {
        "input": {"prompt": "read the missing file", "tools": ["read"]},
        "expected_output": {"required_tools": ["read"], "expected_tool_errors": ["read"]},
        "metadata": {"id": "missing"},
    },
]


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _environment(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A deployment's environment, without a connection to anything."""

    monkeypatch.setenv("PRALE_REPOSITORY_ID", REPOSITORY_ID)
    monkeypatch.setenv("PRALE_API_KEY", API_KEY)
    monkeypatch.setenv("PRALE_PROJECT_ROOT", str(tmp_path / "project"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("PRALE_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "data"))
    monkeypatch.delenv("LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENABLED", raising=False)


@pytest.fixture
def dataset(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "dataset.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(CASES), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


@pytest.fixture
def report_path(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    return tmp_path / "report.json"


def _report(path: Path) -> dict:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def test_a_local_dataset_runs_is_scored_and_is_reported(
    dataset: Path, tmp_path: Path, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture
) -> None:
    provider = ScriptedProvider()
    report = tmp_path / "report.json"

    code = eval_harness.main(
        ["--from-json", str(dataset), "--report", str(report), "--gate", "terminal_success_rate=1"],
        provider=provider,
    )

    printed = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert code == 0
    assert "evaluation plan" in printed
    assert "writing tools      refused" in printed
    # One turn per item per round: two items, two rounds each, on four distinct
    # session ids — each item is its own Agent session.
    assert len(provider.requests) == 4
    assert {request.session_id for request in provider.requests} == {"eval:readme", "eval:missing"}

    payload = _report(report)
    assert [item["id"] for item in payload["items"]] == ["readme", "missing"]
    assert payload["run_name"] is None  # nothing was uploaded, so nothing was named
    by_name = {metric["name"]: metric for metric in payload["metrics"]}
    assert by_name["terminal_success_rate"]["value"] == 1.0
    assert "readme" in printed and "missing" in printed


def test_the_report_carries_what_each_item_was_scored_on(dataset: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    report = tmp_path / "report.json"

    eval_harness.main(["--from-json", str(dataset), "--report", str(report)], provider=ScriptedProvider())

    [readme, missing] = _report(report)["items"]
    scores = {evaluation["name"]: evaluation["value"] for evaluation in readme["evaluations"]}
    assert scores["terminal_success"] == 1.0
    assert scores["required_tools"] == 1.0
    assert scores["answer_contract"] == 1.0

def test_an_item_is_read_whole_into_its_case() -> None:
    case = parse_case(
        {
            "input": {
                "prompt": "read the readme",
                "files": {"README.md": "the readme"},
                "tools": ["read", "repository_explore"],
            },
            "expected_output": {
                "terminal_status": "completed",
                "required_tools": ["read"],
                "forbidden_tools": ["bash"],
                "expected_tool_errors": ["read"],
                "answer_contract": {"contains": ["durable"]},
            },
            "metadata": {"id": "readme-summary", "risk": "normal"},
        }
    )

    assert (case.id, case.tools) == ("readme-summary", ("read", "repository_explore"))
    assert case.files == {"README.md": "the readme"}
    assert case.expectations.required_tools == ("read",)
    assert case.expectations.forbidden_tools == ("bash",)
    assert case.expectations.expected_tool_errors == ("read",)
    assert case.expectations.answer_contract == {"contains": ["durable"]}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "item",
    [
        {"input": {"prompt": "x", "tools": "read"}},  # a string is not a list of tools
        {"input": {"prompt": "x", "tools": ["read", ""]}},
        {"input": {"prompt": "x", "files": ["README.md"]}},
        {"input": {"prompt": "x", "files": {"README.md": 3}}},
        {"input": {"prompt": "x"}, "metadata": {"id": 3}},
        {"input": {"prompt": "x"}, "expected_output": {"answer_contract": ["durable"]}},
        {"input": {"prompt": "x"}, "metadata": "case-1"},
    ],
)
def test_a_malformed_item_is_refused_rather_than_guessed_at(item) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(CaseError):
        parse_case(item)


def test_a_dataset_id_is_only_taken_when_the_item_has_one() -> None:
    assert parse_case({"input": {"prompt": "x"}, "metadata": {"id": "case-1"}}).id == "case-1"
    # An item that never named itself is named by its position instead, so a
    # dataset is a list of distinct cases even when its author left the ids out.
    assert parse_case({"input": {"prompt": "x"}}, fallback_id="item-7").id == "item-7"
    assert parse_case({"input": {"prompt": "x"}, "metadata": {"id": ""}}, fallback_id="item-7").id == "item-7"

def test_the_run_decides_what_a_case_may_use_not_the_case() -> None:
    # An item can write any expectations it likes; the tools are still decided
    # by the deployment running the experiment.
    case = parse_case({"input": {"prompt": "tidy the repo", "tools": ["read", "bash"]}})

    with pytest.raises(CaseError, match="allow_writing"):
        parse_case_tools(case)
    assert parse_case_tools(case, allow_writing=True) == ("read", "bash")


def test_read_only_tools_need_no_flag_and_are_deduplicated() -> None:
    case = EvalCase(id="case-1", prompt="x", tools=("read", "repository_explore", "read"))

    assert parse_case_tools(case) == ("read", "repository_explore")


def test_a_tool_the_runtime_does_not_have_is_refused() -> None:
    # Silently dropping it would turn a dataset bug into a scored failure that
    # blames the Agent for a tool it was never given.
    case = EvalCase(id="case-1", prompt="x", tools=("read", "write_file"))

    with pytest.raises(CaseError, match="write_file"):
        parse_case_tools(case)
    with pytest.raises(CaseError, match="write_file"):
        parse_case_tools(case, allow_writing=True)


def test_every_writing_tool_is_behind_the_same_flag() -> None:
    case = EvalCase(id="case-1", prompt="x", tools=tuple(sorted(WRITING_TOOLS)))

    with pytest.raises(CaseError):
        parse_case_tools(case)

def test_a_path_that_leaves_the_workspace_is_refused(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inner = _Tool()
    tool = ConfinedTool(inner, tmp_path / "workspace")
    (tmp_path / "workspace").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "outside.txt").write_text("not for the agent")

    for attempt in ("../outside.txt", str(tmp_path / "outside.txt"), "/etc/passwd"):
        result = asyncio.run(tool.execute({"path": attempt}))
        assert result.is_error is True
        assert "refused" in str(result.content)
    # Refused before the tool saw it: nothing was read and nothing was escaped.
    assert inner.seen == []

"""The deployment's configuration, parsed from the environment.

Two entry points read the same values: ``api/serve.py`` builds a web
deployment from them, and the evaluation harness (``scripts/eval_harness.py``)
builds a provider from them to run a dataset offline.  Keeping the parsing here
is what stops the second from growing a private copy of the first's defaults,
and what keeps an offline run free of the web framework: nothing in this module
imports starlette.

The parsing is separated from the composition on purpose.  A misconfigured
deployment should fail with an explanation, at startup, before anything opens;
a value read from inside a driver fails much further from its cause.
"""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from agent_harness.api.errors import ProjectConfigError
from agent_harness.api.project import ProjectRuntimeConfig
from agent_harness.integrations.langfuse import LangfuseConfig
from agent_harness.integrations.repository_explorer import RepositoryScanLimits

DEFAULT_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
"""Loopback by default: a deployment that should be reachable says so."""

DEFAULT_PORT = 8787
DEFAULT_MODEL = "deepseek-flash"
"""The provider's current fast model; ``PRALE_MODEL`` overrides it."""
DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions"
"""The whole endpoint, not a base to append a path to."""
DEFAULT_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS = 10.0
"""Bound the time Uvicorn waits for long-lived SSE requests to finish."""
DEFAULT_LANE = "main"
DATA_DIR_NAME = ".prale"
"""Where the stores live when ``PRALE_DATA_DIR`` does not say otherwise."""

BUILTIN_TOOLS = ("read", "write", "edit", "bash", "repository_explore")
"""The local tool set, named individually because enabling ``bash`` is a decision."""

DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_DRIVES = 8
"""How many turns one deployment drives at once, unless it is configured otherwise.

Each drive is an agent loop that may run tools, so an unbounded number of
simultaneously admitted turns is a resource decision rather than a detail.
Refusing *before* the prompt is written keeps a refusal from leaving an
undriven durable operation behind.
"""

    "BUILTIN_TOOLS",
    "DATA_DIR_NAME",
    "DEFAULT_BASE_URL",

def config(self) -> ProjectRuntimeConfig:
        return ProjectRuntimeConfig(
            project_root=self.project_root,
            repository_id=self.repository_id,
            sessions_dir=self.sessions_dir,
            catalog_db=self.catalog_db,
            memory_db=self.memory_db,
            skill_db=self.skill_db,
            project_id=self.project_id,
            default_lane=self.default_lane,
        )

    @property
    def secrets(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Every value the log filter must never print.

        The token map is credential → identity (that is the shape
        ``StaticTokenAuthenticator`` looks a bearer credential up in), so its
        keys are the secrets and its values are the names a log may show.
        """

        tracing = () if self.langfuse is None else (self.langfuse.secret_key,)
        return (self.api_key, *self.tokens, *tracing)

    def describe(self) -> str:
        """The deployment as text, with credentials reduced to their presence."""

        memory = "off" if self.memory_db is None else str(self.memory_db)
        skills = "off" if self.skill_db is None else str(self.skill_db)
        prompt = "none" if self.memory_prompt_file is None else str(self.memory_prompt_file)
        tools = ", ".join(self.tools) or "none"
        tokens = ", ".join(sorted(self.tokens.values())) or "none (unauthenticated)"
        return "\n".join(
            [
                f"project_root      {self.project_root}",
                f"repository_id     {self.repository_id}",
                f"project_id        {self.project_id or self.repository_id}",
                f"default_lane      {self.default_lane}",
                f"sessions_dir      {self.sessions_dir}",
                f"catalog_db        {self.catalog_db}",
                f"memory_db         {memory}",
                f"skill_db          {skills}",
                f"provider          deepseek {self.model} @ {self.base_url}",
                f"api_key           {'<set>' if self.api_key else '<unset>'}",
                f"tokens            {tokens}",
                f"tools             {tools}",
                f"traces            {'on' if self.traces else 'off'}",
                f"memory_prompt     {prompt}",
                f"max_drives        {self.max_concurrent_drives}",
                f"repository_explore {'on' if 'repository_explore' in self.tools else 'off'}",
                f"repository_scan   files={self.repository_scan_limits.max_files} "
                f"bytes={self.repository_scan_limits.max_total_bytes} "
                f"file_bytes={self.repository_scan_limits.max_file_bytes} ms={self.repository_scan_limits.max_scan_ms}",
                f"repository_export_tokens {self.repository_export_tokens}",
                f"repository_max_concurrent_indexes {self.repository_max_concurrent_indexes}",
                f"max_connections   {self.max_connections if self.max_connections else 'unlimited'}",
                f"graceful_shutdown {self.graceful_shutdown_seconds}s",
                f"listen            {self.host}:{self.port}",
                "langfuse          off" if self.langfuse is None else self.langfuse.describe(),
            ]
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls, environ: Mapping[str, str], *, cwd: Path | None = None) -> "Settings":
        """Parse the deployment's values, or explain what is missing.

        ``environ`` is a parameter rather than ``os.environ`` so that the
        parsing can be exercised without a subprocess.
        """

        base = Path(cwd or Path.cwd())
        root = _path(environ, "PRALE_PROJECT_ROOT", base)
        data_dir = _path(environ, "PRALE_DATA_DIR", root / DATA_DIR_NAME)
        repository_id = environ.get("PRALE_REPOSITORY_ID", "").strip()
        if not repository_id:
            raise ProjectConfigError(
                "PRALE_REPOSITORY_ID is required: a stable identity (for example a canonical Git remote), "
                "not a checkout path"
            )
        api_key = environ.get("PRALE_API_KEY", "").strip()
        if not api_key:
            raise ProjectConfigError("PRALE_API_KEY is required: this deployment needs a provider credential")
        model = environ.get("PRALE_MODEL", "").strip() or DEFAULT_MODEL
        tools = _tools(environ.get("PRALE_TOOLS", ""))
        unknown = sorted(set(tools) - set(BUILTIN_TOOLS))
        if unknown:
            raise ProjectConfigError(f"PRALE_TOOLS names unknown tools: {unknown}; known: {list(BUILTIN_TOOLS)}")
        tokens = _tokens(environ.get("PRALE_TOKENS", ""))
        # Parsed here, with the rest, so that an enabled-but-unconfigurable
        # tracing setup stops the process before it serves a single turn — and
        # so the sanitizer knows the credentials it must never upload.
        langfuse = LangfuseConfig.from_environment(
            environ,
            project_root=str(root),
            secrets=(api_key, *tokens),
        )
        prompt_file = environ.get("PRALE_MEMORY_PROMPT", "").strip()
        memory_db = (
            None if _off(environ, "PRALE_MEMORY") else _path(environ, "PRALE_MEMORY_DB", data_dir / "memory.sqlite")
        )
        skill_db = (
            None if _off(environ, "PRALE_SKILLS") else _path(environ, "PRALE_SKILL_DB", data_dir / "skills.sqlite")
        )
        if skill_db is not None and memory_db is None:
            # Said here rather than left to composition: skill extraction reads
            # L0 archives through the memory store, and the runtime's own error
            # for that mismatch arrives much further from the configuration.
            raise ProjectConfigError("PRALE_SKILLS requires the memory store: extraction reads L0 archives from it")
        repository_index_dir = None
        if "repository_explore" in tools:
            raw_index_dir = environ.get("PRALE_REPOSITORY_INDEX_DIR", "").strip()
            if not raw_index_dir:
                raise ProjectConfigError("PRALE_REPOSITORY_INDEX_DIR is required when repository_explore is enabled")
            repository_index_dir = Path(raw_index_dir).expanduser()
            try:
                repository_index_dir.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve(strict=True))
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ProjectConfigError("PRALE_REPOSITORY_INDEX_DIR must be outside PRALE_PROJECT_ROOT")
        try:
            scan_limits = RepositoryScanLimits(
                max_files=_int(environ, "PRALE_REPOSITORY_MAX_FILES", 8_000),
                max_file_bytes=_int(environ, "PRALE_REPOSITORY_MAX_FILE_BYTES", 1_000_000),
                max_total_bytes=_int(environ, "PRALE_REPOSITORY_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES", 32_000_000),
                max_scan_ms=_int(environ, "PRALE_REPOSITORY_MAX_SCAN_MS", 60_000),
            )
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ProjectConfigError(str(error)) from error
        repository_export_tokens = _int(environ, "PRALE_REPOSITORY_MAX_EXPORT_TOKENS", 6_000)
        if not 256 <= repository_export_tokens <= 6_000:
            raise ProjectConfigError("PRALE_REPOSITORY_MAX_EXPORT_TOKENS must be between 256 and 6000")
        return cls(
            project_root=root,
            repository_id=repository_id,
            project_id=environ.get("PRALE_PROJECT_ID", "").strip() or None,
            default_lane=environ.get("PRALE_DEFAULT_LANE", "").strip() or DEFAULT_LANE,
            sessions_dir=_path(environ, "PRALE_SESSIONS_DIR", data_dir / "sessions"),
            catalog_db=_path(environ, "PRALE_CATALOG_DB", data_dir / "catalog.sqlite"),
            memory_db=memory_db,
            skill_db=skill_db,
======

    A store whose parent directory is missing does not start an empty store, it
    fails to open at all — so a first run with a fresh ``PRALE_DATA_DIR`` would
    end in a sqlite error rather than a working deployment.  Creating the paths
    is the entry point's job: it is what decided they exist.
    """

    wanted = [settings.sessions_dir, settings.catalog_db.parent]
    wanted.extend(store.parent for store in (settings.memory_db, settings.skill_db) if store is not None)
    for directory in wanted:
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def build_application(settings: Settings) -> Deployment:
    """Compose the deployment: provider, tools, stores, then the adapter."""

    prepare_directories(settings)
    provider = DeepSeekProvider(
        api_key=settings.api_key,
        model=settings.model,
        base_url=settings.base_url,
        timeout_seconds=settings.timeout_seconds,
    )
    # Built before anything durable opens: this is the one step that can still
    # fail on configuration (the SDK is an optional extra), and failing here
    # leaves no store and no server behind.
    telemetry = None if settings.langfuse is None else LangfuseTelemetry(settings.langfuse)
    explorer = _repository_explorer(settings)
    available_tools = (
        create_builtin_tools(settings.project_root, repository_explorer=explorer) if settings.tools else ()
    )
    tools = tuple(tool for tool in available_tools if tool.name in settings.tools)
    stores: list[SQLiteMemoryStore | SQLiteSkillStore] = []
    memory_store = None
    skill_store = None
    if settings.memory_db is not None:
        memory_store = SQLiteMemoryStore(settings.memory_db)
        stores.append(memory_store)
    if settings.skill_db is not None:
        skill_store = SQLiteSkillStore(settings.skill_db)
        stores.append(skill_store)
    web = create_app(
        settings.config,
        provider,
        tools=tools,
        memory_store=memory_store,
        skill_store=skill_store,
        memory_extractor=build_extractor(settings),
        skill_reviewer=CodingSkillReviewer(provider) if skill_store is not None else None,
        trace_recorder=settings.traces,
        telemetry=telemetry,
        tokens=settings.tokens,
        max_concurrent_drives=settings.max_concurrent_drives,
    )
    return Deployment(web, tuple(stores))


def _repository_explorer(settings: Settings) -> RepositoryExplorerTool | None:
    if "repository_explore" not in settings.tools:
        return None
    assert settings.repository_index_dir is not None
    try:
        config = RepositoryExplorerConfig(
            settings.project_root,
            settings.repository_index_dir,
            limits=settings.repository_scan_limits,
            max_export_tokens=settings.repository_export_tokens,
            cache_max_entries=settings.repository_cache_entries,
            cache_ttl_ms=settings.repository_cache_ttl_ms,
            max_concurrent_indexes=settings.repository_max_concurrent_indexes,
        )
        return RepositoryExplorerTool(config, TreeSitterRepositoryIndexer(config))
    except (RepositoryIndexError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ProjectConfigError(f"repository_explore is unavailable: {error}") from error


def configure_logging(level: str, secrets: Iterable[str]) -> None:
    """One root handler, carrying the redacting filter, for every logger."""

    handler = logging.StreamHandler()
    handler.addFilter(RedactingFilter(secrets))
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s"))
    root = logging.getLogger()
    for existing in list(root.handlers):
        root.removeHandler(existing)
    root.addHandler(handler)
    root.setLevel(level.upper())


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="prale-web", description="Serve one agent-harness project over HTTP.")

60:tree-sitter 的每种语言标签查询（`.scm`）是实现的一部分，必须作为 wheel package data 随 `agent_harness` 分发，并以 `importlib.resources` 加载；不得依赖源码 checkout 中的相对路径。每次查询变更都要提升 `indexer_version`，使旧 tag cache 失效。
====
# 仓库探索工具设计

## 1. 目标与范围

本设计为 PRALE 增加一个**按需调用**的仓库探索工具。它帮助 Agent 在修改代码前快速回答：某个功能位于哪些文件、关键符号在哪里定义、哪些模块引用它、应优先阅读哪些局部实现。

它借鉴 `/root/vibe/CoLe/aider` 的 RepoMap 思路：从源码提取 definition/reference 标签，构建文件间引用图，以个性化 PageRank 排序，再在确定 token 预算内渲染关键文件和代码行。它**不是**把仓库地图自动拼入每次 LLM 请求的 prompt。

首个完整交付聚焦于**以明确 identifier 或已知代码为种子的引用导航**：本机已配置项目根目录内的只读源码探索、多语言语法标签、路径/标识符聚焦、固定 wire 输出预算、进程外 tag 缓存，以及在普通工具调用协议下的崩溃恢复。模糊 `query` 是辅助提示，不能替代 identifier 排序。

不在范围：

- 从任意用户提交路径读取、跨项目探索或把 `repository_id` 当作文件系统权限；
- 让 runtime/domain 依赖 tree-sitter、git、图算法库或 aider；
- 自动向每一轮 provider context 注入仓库地图；
- 以 RepoMap 取代 `read`、`bash` 或对当前工作树的验证；
- 将索引结果写入 Session、长期记忆或 Skill 资产作为仓库当前状态的权威副本。

## 2. 术语与不变量

| 术语 | 含义 | 非含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 仓库索引（Repository Index） | 给定一个项目 checkout 与版本指纹后，可重建的源码标签和引用图 | Session 状态、长期记忆、工作树真相的持久副本 |
| 仓库地图（Repository Map） | 由仓库索引按一次请求的焦点和预算导出的紧凑视图 | 每轮隐式 prompt 前缀 |
| 探索快照（Exploration Snapshot） | 某次调用实际输出的路径、片段和其内容指纹 | 全仓库的原子快照或对后续调用仍然新鲜的承诺 |
| 工作区根（workspace root） | 服务端 `ProjectRuntimeConfig.project_root` 规范化后的允许读取根 | 模型可覆盖的参数或稳定仓库身份 |

以下不变量必须成立：

1. 只有服务端配置的 `workspace root` 决定可读取范围；所有相对路径在 resolve 后必须仍位于该根目录内。
2. 探索结果是一次普通、持久化的 tool result，只能经所在 branch 的正常上下文投影与 compaction 参与后续 provider request；它不得成为跨 branch 或每轮自动注入的全局隐式上下文。
3. 索引与缓存均非权威数据。任何 edit、测试或结论都必须以当前 checkout 的 `read`/验证工具结果为准。
4. 该工具不写工作树、不执行项目代码、不访问网络；其可恢复重放语义为 `safe`。
5. 缓存未命中、索引失败、符号不存在和输出截断必须显式返回状态，不能伪造完整或新鲜的地图。
6. “一致”只保证最终输出的每个源码片段与其记录的内容指纹一致；不承诺索引期间全仓库未改变。未输出文件的并发变化不得迫使一次昂贵的全仓重扫。

## 3. 位置与依赖边界

```text
api/deployment composition
       │  仅按服务端配置注册
       ▼
integrations/repository_explorer.py
       ├─ RepositoryExplorerTool       # AgentTool adapter
       ├─ RepositoryIndexer            # tags / graph / ranking protocol
       ├─ TreeSitterRepositoryIndexer  # 可选依赖实现
       └─ RepositoryTagCache            # 受控、checkout 外的 tag 缓存
       │
       ▼
runtime.tools.AgentTool                # 不知道索引细节
       │
       ▼
domain/                                # 不导入任何上述模块
```

`RepositoryExplorerTool` 与现有 `ReadTool` 同属 `integrations/`：它实现 `name`、`description`、`input_schema`、`replay_policy` 和 `async execute()`，但 runtime 只能看见 `AgentTool` 协议。生产依赖（如 tree-sitter/grep-ast）放进新的可选 extra，例如 `repository-explorer`；未安装时由 deployment composition 拒绝启���该工具，而不是在 core package 中静默降级。`Settings.from_environment()` 必须仍能解析并打印配置，保持 `--print-config` 不要求安装 optional extra 的既有语义。

不得直接 import aider 的 `RepoMap` 作为生产实现。aider 的实现同时耦合 CLI `InputOutput`/spinner、模型 token counter、`.aider.tags.cache.*` 工作树缓存和其刷新策略。PRALE 可以实现小型、确定性的 PageRank，避免为此引入 `networkx`；若复制任何 aider 源码或标签查询，必须保留 Apache-2.0 归属与许可通知。PRALE 的 adapter、DTO、缓存位置和错误模型必须由本设计定义。

tree-sitter 的每种语言标签查询（`.scm`）是实现的一部分，必须作为 wheel package data 随 `agent_harness` 分发，并以 `importlib.resources` 加载；不得依赖源码 checkout 中的相对路径。每次查询变更都要提升 `indexer_version`，使旧 tag cache 失效。

"""The trace Langfuse actually receives, asserted against the real SDK.

Skipped where the extra is not installed, because the runtime does not depend
on it.  The client is built once for the whole module and shared: OpenTelemetry
allows a single global tracer provider per process, so a second client would
export through the first one's exporter and an assertion here could pass
against a trace this file never made.

Everything below is read back out of the SDK's own span objects, after
``aclose()`` has flushed them — the same path a Langfuse deployment sees.
"""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from typing import Any

import pytest

pytest.importorskip("langfuse")

from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter  # noqa: E402

from agent_harness.api.harness import Harness  # noqa: E402
from agent_harness.integrations.langfuse import LangfuseConfig, LangfuseTelemetry  # noqa: E402

PROMPT = "summarise the readme"
ANSWER = "The readme describes a durable agent runtime."
FILE_TEXT = "the readme"

_EXPORTER = InMemorySpanExporter()
_CLIENT: Any = None


class ScriptedProvider:
    """Every turn first asks for the file, then answers."""

    model = MODEL

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.requests: list[GenerationRequest] = []

    async def generate(self, request: GenerationRequest) -> AssistantResult:
        self.requests.append(request)
        if len(self.requests) % 2:
            return AssistantResult(
                content="",
                usage={"prompt_tokens": 40, "completion_tokens": 8},
                tool_calls=(ToolCall(f"call-{len(self.requests)}", "read", {"path": "README.md"}),),
            )
        return AssistantResult(content=ANSWER, usage={"prompt_tokens": 60, "completion_tokens": 12})


class ReadTool:
    """A stand-in for the repository reader: the trace shape is what matters."""

    name = "read"
    description = "Read a file."
    input_schema = {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}}}
    replay_policy = "safe"

    def __init__(self, *, fails: bool = False) -> None:
        self._fails = fails

    async def execute(self, arguments):
        if self._fails:
            return ToolExecutionResult(content={"error": "no such file"}, is_error=True)
        return ToolExecutionResult(content={"path": arguments["path"], "text": FILE_TEXT})

def test_the_metadata_profile_uploads_no_text_from_the_turn() -> None:
    asyncio.run(_run(capture="metadata"))

    uploaded = _everything(_finished())
    for text in (PROMPT, ANSWER, FILE_TEXT, "README.md"):
        assert text not in uploaded
    # It still says *what* was sent, only never the text itself: a length and a
    # stable digest, which is what lets two runs of the same prompt be matched.
    root = _root()
    assert _observation(root, "input")["prompt"] == {
        "chars": len(f"{PROMPT} #1"),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(f"{PROMPT} #1".encode()).hexdigest()[:12],
    }
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.observation.metadata.capture"] == "metadata"


def test_the_redacted_profile_uploads_the_turn_with_its_numbers() -> None:
    asyncio.run(_run(capture="redacted"))

    uploaded = _everything(_finished())
    assert PROMPT in uploaded
    assert ANSWER in uploaded
    assert FILE_TEXT in uploaded

def test_observing_a_turn_does_not_change_it() -> None:
    async def run(sink) -> tuple:
        storage = MemoryStorage()
        provider = Provider([_tool_turn("echo", "call-1"), AssistantResult(content="done", usage={})])
        lane = await (await Harness.open("session-1", storage, tools=(EchoTool(),), telemetry=sink)).acquire_lane(
            "main"
        )
        await lane.prompt("run it", operation_id="op-1")

        result = await lane.drive(provider)
        # Identifiers and clocks differ between two runs by construction; what a
        # turn produced must not.
        entries = [(entry.type, entry.payload) for entry in await storage.scan_branch(result.tip_id)]
        spans = sorted((span.kind, span.attempt, span.outcome) for span in await storage.list_spans("op-1"))
        usage = [(record.input_tokens, record.output_tokens) for record in await storage.list_usage("op-1")]
        return (result.status, result.error_code), entries, spans, usage

    async def scenario() -> None:
        observed = await run(Collector())
        unobserved = await run(None)

        assert observed == unobserved

    asyncio.run(scenario())


def test_a_sink_that_raises_is_still_only_a_sink() -> None:
    async def scenario() -> None:
        class RudeCollector:
            def record(self, event) -> None:
                raise RuntimeError("the observer is broken")

        storage = MemoryStorage()
        provider = Provider([AssistantResult(content="done", usage={})])
        lane = await (await Harness.open("session-1", storage, telemetry=RudeCollector())).acquire_lane("main")
        await lane.prompt("run it", operation_id="op-1")

        result = await lane.drive(provider)

        assert result.status == "completed"
        [span] = await storage.list_spans("op-1")
        assert span.outcome == "completed"
        branch = await storage.scan_branch(result.tip_id)
        assert branch[-1].payload["content"] == "done"

    asyncio.run(scenario())

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "prale-agent-harness"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Durable Python runtime for pi-style agents"
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[project.scripts]
# The deployment entry point: reads its configuration from the environment
# (see deploy/web.env.example).  It lives behind the ``web`` extra, so install
# that before running it.
prale-web = "agent_harness.api.serve:main"

[project.optional-dependencies]
# The core library binds no HTTP framework: only ``agent_harness.api.web``
# imports starlette, and it is imported by deployments that install this extra.
web = ["starlette>=0.45", "uvicorn>=0.30"]
# Tracing is optional and off unless LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENABLED is set: the core
# runtime publishes facts to a local protocol, and only
# ``agent_harness.integrations.langfuse`` imports this SDK.
langfuse = ["langfuse>=4,<5"]
repository-explorer = [
  "tree-sitter>=0.23,<0.26",
  "tree-sitter-bash>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-c>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-cpp>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-c-sharp>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-go>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-java>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-javascript>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-php>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-python>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-ruby>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-rust>=0.23",
  "tree-sitter-typescript>=0.23",
]
dev = ["mypy>=1.13", "pytest>=8", "ruff>=0.8", "httpx>=0.27", "starlette>=0.45"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/agent_harness"]
include = ["src/agent_harness/integrations/repository_queries/*.scm"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q"
# ``scripts`` is on the path so the evaluation CLI can be tested as the module
# it is, rather than through a subprocess that hides its exit code.
pythonpath = ["src", "scripts"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP"]

[tool.mypy]

# Memory promotion is an LLM stage and its prompt is a deployment artifact,
# not configuration. Without this file L0 archives remain browsable but no
# L1/L2/L3 memory is proposed. Skill evolution does not depend on this file:
# when both MemoryStore and SkillStore are enabled, the bundled coding reviewer
# uses the configured provider to review frozen L0 archives. The file's text is
# the memory system prompt; each stage's payload (including the coding memory
# policy) is sent as the user message with "stage" naming l1, l2_create,
# l2_update, l2_merge or l3.
#PRALE_MEMORY_PROMPT=/etc/prale/memory-prompt.md

# --- tracing (optional) ---------------------------------------------------
# Upload one trace per operation to Langfuse (cloud or self-hosted), for
# offline evaluation.  Needs the langfuse extra.  Off unless the switch is set,
# and the switch without both keys is refused at startup: a half-configured
# deployment would look monitored while collecting nothing.
#LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENABLED=true
#LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-replace-me
#LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-replace-me
# Cloud default; point this at a self-hosted instance to keep traces on your
# own network.
#LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=https://cloud.langfuse.com
# Tags every trace in the project.  Only development, staging and production
# are accepted, and the value is part of the project's identity, not a label
# you can change per run.
#LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT=development
# Release/version label for the code that produced a trace (a tag, or the
# commit the deployment runs).  Set this when comparing two versions of the
# harness over the same dataset.
#PRALE_LANGFUSE_RELEASE=v0.1.0
# How much of a turn may leave the process.  ``metadata`` (the default) uploads
# sizes and hashes, never prompt, message, memory or tool text; ``redacted``
# uploads text with secrets removed; ``full`` uploads it as it is.  Choose
# deliberately: whatever this names is what leaves your network.
#PRALE_LANGFUSE_CAPTURE=metadata
# Bounded queue between the agent loop and the uploader.  A full queue drops
# facts (a terminal event displaces an older non-terminal one) rather than
# slowing a turn down.
#PRALE_LANGFUSE_QUEUE_SIZE=1000
# Seconds to drain and flush on shutdown.
#PRALE_LANGFUSE_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5

# An evaluation run reads this same file.  ``scripts/eval_harness.py`` drives
# the harness over a dataset in the project you would deploy, so the model and
# the tracing keys above are the ones it uses:
#
#   (set -a; . ./web.env; set +a) python scripts/eval_harness.py --help
#
# ``--from-json dataset.json`` runs a dataset from a file and uploads nothing;
# ``--from-json dataset.json --upload-to <name>`` writes those cases into a
# Langfuse dataset and stops, creating it if this is the first upload; and
# ``--dataset <name>`` reads the items back and uploads the run.  The last two
# need the langfuse extra and the switch above; all three write the scores into
# the traces they produce.
#
# What the traces carry is PRALE_LANGFUSE_CAPTURE, so a deployment that wants
# prompts and answers readable in the Langfuse UI raises it to ``redacted``
# deliberately — the default ``metadata`` deliberately uploads no text at all.

# --- listener -------------------------------------------------------------
# Loopback by default.  Binding elsewhere is what makes tokens matter.
#PRALE_HOST=127.0.0.1

output.content:
44:## 追踪与评测
46:`agent_harness.integrations.langfuse` 在每次 settlement 提交之后，把执行事实（operation 起止、每次 generation、每次 tool attempt）投影为 Langfuse observation。它订阅事实流，不参与 Drive 的判定：整条 trace 丢失也不改变 Session。默认关闭，需设置 `LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENABLED` 与两个 key 才启用（启动时只给开关不给 key 会被拒绝），并需要 `langfuse` extra。
50:`scripts/eval_harness.py` 用同一套环境变量把数据集跑成一次可对比的评测：每个 case 在自己的临时 workspace 与 SQLite session 中运行真实的 Agent（同一 Session、Drive、工具与 settlement 路径），再由 `agent_harness.integrations.evaluation` 从已提交的事实而非模型散文里打分。
53:python scripts/eval_harness.py --from-json dataset.json --report report.json  # 只本地运行，不上传
54:python scripts/eval_harness.py --from-json dataset.json --upload-to prale/harness-regression  # 建/更新固定集
55:python scripts/eval_harness.py --dataset prale/harness-regression             # 从 Langfuse 取物品并回传
58:`--upload-to` 把解析后的 case 逐个写进数据集（case id 即 item id，重复上传是更新而不是翻倍），写完即停，不打分；仓库里的 JSON 因此始终是「这个固定集是什么」的真相，Langfuse 是两次运行被并排比较的地方。`--run-name` 建议填 git sha 或 tag，配合 `PRALE_LANGFUSE_RELEASE` 才能看出是哪一版跑出的分数。
60:退出码即接口：0 已打分，1 有 gate 未达标（`--gate terminal_success_rate=0.9`），2 在任何模型调用之前被拒绝——数据集有歧义、scorer 或 gate 不可用、case 要求本次不授予的工具。`--dry-run` 只打印计划。打分口径与沙箱边界见 `src/agent_harness/integrations/evaluation.py`：`read`/`write`/`edit` 的路径被限制在 case 的临时工作目录内，但 `bash` 不是操作系统沙箱，因此写入类工具默认不授予，需要 `--allow-writing`。

def _finished() -> list:

def _attributes(span: Any) -> dict:

def _observation(span: Any, field: str) -> Any:
    """A structured observation field, as Langfuse stores it.

    The SDK serializes anything that is not a scalar into the attribute, so
    this is the decoding a Langfuse reader does on the other side.

def _everything(spans: list) -> str:

    root = _root()
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.observation.type"] == "agent"
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.internal.is_app_root"] is True
    # The deployment's identity travels with every span in the trace.
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.environment"] == ENVIRONMENT
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.release"] == RELEASE
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.version"] == RELEASE
    assert _attributes(root)["session.id"] == "session-1"
    assert "prale" in _attributes(root)["langfuse.trace.tags"]
    assert _attributes(root)["langfuse.trace.metadata.operation_id"] == "op-1"
    # The trace's input and output are the root observation's, which is what an
    # evaluator binds a dataset item to.
    assert _observation(root, "input") == {"prompt": f"{PROMPT} #1"}
    assert _observation(root, "output")["content"] == ANSWER

    generations = [span for span in _children(root) if span.name == "prale.generate"]
    [tool] = [span for span in _children(root) if span.name.startswith("prale.tool.")]
    assert [span.name for span in _children(root)] == ["prale.generate", "prale.tool.read", "prale.generate"]
    assert [_attributes(span)["langfuse.observation.type"] for span in generations] == ["generation", "generation"]
    assert _attributes(tool)["langfuse.observation.type"] == "tool"
    # The trace's identity is on the children too, not only on the root.
    assert {_attributes(span)["session.id"] for span in _children(root)} == {"session-1"}
    assert result.status == "completed"

def _revision(root: Path) -> str:
    # Do not shell out: a git revision is optional human context, while hashes
    # attached to rendered source are the actual output freshness guarantee.
    head = root / ".git" / "HEAD"
    try:
        value = head.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        if value.startswith("ref: "):
            value = (root / ".git" / value[5:]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        return value[:12] if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{7,64}", value) else "worktree"
    except OSError:
        return "worktree"

specs/long-term-memory-implementation-spec.md:239:L1 worker 必须：读取未消费 L0 item 与受限祖先链背景、执行质量/敏感信息门控、产出协议化候选、在当前 L1 中检索相似项（类型内与类型间）、作出 `create | supersede | merge | no_op` 决定，并原子写入 L1、来源关系、索引更新任务和审计。对 code 模式，extractor 还必须接收由冻结 L0 派生的 CodingEvidence（仓库 ID、有限路径集合、带 entry ID 的工具 outcome）；工具成功/失败可作为事实证据，但 assistant 的计划或诊断未经结果验证不得沉淀为事实。路径、symbol、测试或命令的引用必须说明其作用、约束或 outcome，不能仅保存裸字符串。L2/L3 只消费成功的下层 watermark；L2 失败不可触发 L3。LLM 输出必须先经 JSON/Markdown schema 验证和长度/类型校验，再写入；校验失败**必须**记为不可重试错误，不得重试同一非法输出。
specs/long-term-memory-implementation-spec.md:251:`RecallQuery` 含当前用户请求、lane/branch 可见上下文摘要和可选 task；`RecallBudget` 至少含 `timeout_ms`、`max_l1_items`、`min_score`、`max_item_chars`、`max_total_chars`、`include_l3`、`include_l2` 与按 L1 类型的配额。默认：5 秒、最多 5 条 L1、最低分 0.3、必须设置总字符预算（建议 6,000 字符）。与参考实现不同，本 harness 不允许 `0` 表示无限注入，避免挤占 effect intent 的可恢复请求上下文；`0` 在此**必须**被解释为“该类别不注入”。

specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:170:| 10. 长期资产（可选） | 持久化调度器与 runtime 生命周期、Session→L0 trace archive、L1--L3、Skill buffer/review、资产检索、保留/GC 与 SQLite | 跨 Session 资产经 scope 隔离；后台失败不阻塞 Drive；冻结 source snapshot、召回/Skill 版本进入 effect intent；进程重启后延迟任务不丢失且只执行一次 |
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:218:**决策：** `assistant.effect_pending` intent 保存 `model`、`stream_options` 与 `content_checkpoint`。支持流式能力的 provider 每收到一个内容帧就原子替换该 state 并发出 `message_update`；流结束后仍通过正常 settlement 写入 assistant entry 和 usage。checkpoint 是同一 effect 的内部恢复进度，不写 execution trace/L0 `custom` record；TraceRecorder 只记录 effect intent、retry、tool outcome 与 terminal settlement，避免每个 token 复制完整 context。`recover()` 默认只收束未知 provider outcome；若已知 pending tool 为 `safe`，调用方必须以 `recover(provider)` 提供继续运行所需的 provider。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:270:### ADR-013：L0 是冻结的 Session trace archive，而非当前上下文的副本
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:272:Session entry tree 是已结算对话的权威来源，但 compaction、navigation、fork、删除和替换式 operation state 使其不能被后台 worker 延迟地当作“当前轨迹”读取。terminal settlement 因而冻结 branch entry IDs/hash，并以 outbox 异步 materialize 不可变 L0 archive；需要 effect/retry 级审计时，额外以 append-only TraceRecord 保存。此选择避免丢失原始历史，也避免将瞬态 event 或可变 checkpoint 错当完整事实。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:276:**背景：** 阶段 10 需要延迟执行（L1 成功后延迟触发 L2）、失败退避重试和 outbox 重扫，但现有运行时只有进程内 `asyncio` 原语。当前 `RetryPolicy.not_before` 只被写入、从没有任何组件在到期后唤醒它。同时 `MemoryRuntime`/`SkillEvolutionRuntime` 没有明确的启动/关闭语义，未被 `close` 的后台任务会在事件循环结束或被丢弃时静默消失，留下 `running` 状态的 job 和已过期的 lease。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:282:### ADR-015：L0 archive 存增量、以 item watermark 消费
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:284:**背景：** ADR-013 规定了 terminal settlement 冻结 branch entry IDs 并 materialize 不可变 L0 archive，但没有定义 archive 的边界。若每个 operation 都保存它可见的完整 branch，共同前缀会被每个 operation 重复存储，总存储量随会话长度退化为 O(n²)，且单次 capture 的写入量随时间线性增长。反之若只保存“最后几条消息”，extractor 既没有背景，也无法正确表达 fork 前的历史。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:286:**决策：** archive 是**投递单位**，`TraceItem` 是**消费单位**。archive 只保存 base tip 之后的增量 entries（base tip 取自 `OperationMeta.source_tip_id`，并同时出现在 terminal result 的 `from_tip_id`），另以 `parent_archive_id` 与最多 K 个 `ancestor_item_ids` 携带受限背景。`MemoryStore` 为每个 item 分配 scope 内单调递增的 `store_seq`，L1 的 watermark 是 `store_seq` 而不是 archive 边界，因此一个 archive 可以被部分消费而不丢失位置。重复 materialize 由 capture key 与 `(archive_id, source_entry_id)` 双重去重。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:288:**后果：** 存储与写入量回到 O(n)，archive 可被部分消费，且 fork 或 navigation 之后 archive 仍精确对应该 operation 新增的 entries。背景必须由 L0 自身沿 archive 链解析，不能回读 Session。代价是 archive 之间存在引用关系：GC 必须保证被 watermark 或 supersedes 链引用的记录不被回收，且父 archive 缺失时要显式记录缺口而不是重建。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:294:**决策：** `delete` 不再立即 unlink。它先写入 durable 删除标记，把该 Session 的未送达 outbox 提升为高优先级投递，仅在所有 outbox 已 delivered（或人工判定为不可投递）后才执行 unlink。dispatcher 遇到 entry 缺失时**必须**进入可观测 dead letter，绝不能回读 Session 或用当前 branch 补齐。fork 或复制不受此约束：L0 archive 一经 materialize 即独立于 Session 生命周期。
specs/pi-harness-implementation-plan.md:302:**决策：** Web UI 位于核心外的应用适配层，以受权 session catalog 定位一库一 Session；新增只读 trace/memory facade 而不将 SQL 或 storage 私有对象暴露给 HTTP。每个 LLM/tool effect attempt 追加 durable span（`domain/effects.py` 的 `EffectSpan` 与 `UsageRecord`），其开始与 intent 对齐，结束与 outcome、operation state、usage 一起原子结算。L1--L3 观察按配置的 `MemoryScope` 查询。不同 outcome 与耗时的编码规则见 §5.1���完整接口、迁移和验收见 [Web UI 实施计划](web-ui-implementation-plan.md)。

# ruff: noqa

MemoryLevel = Literal["l0", "l1", "l2", "l3"]
AtomicMemoryType = Literal["work_fact", "work_task", "work_method", "work_artifact"]
AtomicMemoryStatus = Literal["active", "superseded", "rejected"]

class PromotionConflict(Exception):

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, init=False)
class MemoryScope:
    """Repository ownership for L0--L2 memory assets.

    A process represents one person's agent, so identity is deliberately not a
    memory authorization dimension.  ``repository_id`` must be a stable,
    caller-supplied identifier (for example a canonical Git remote), not an
    ephemeral checkout path.  The optional legacy arguments only keep old
    serialized callers readable; new callers must pass one repository ID.
    """

    repository_id: str

    def __init__(
        self,
        repository_id: str,
        legacy_agent_id: str | None = None,
        legacy_user_id: str | None = None,
        legacy_task_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if legacy_agent_id is not None or legacy_user_id is not None or legacy_task_id is not None:
            # Compatibility only: old (team, agent, user, task) callers become
            # one repository namespace and no longer grant identity sharing.
            repository_id = "/".join(
                part for part in (repository_id, legacy_agent_id or "", legacy_user_id or "") if part
            )
        if not repository_id or "\x00" in repository_id:
            raise ValueError("repository_id must be non-empty and contain no NUL")
        object.__setattr__(self, "repository_id", repository_id)

    @property
    def visibility_key(self) -> str:
        return self.repository_id

    @property
    def storage_key(self) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
        """Compatibility mapping for the pre-v4 SQLite physical columns."""
        return (self.repository_id, "", "")

def content_hash(value: str) -> str:
    return sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()


def validate_atomic_candidate(candidate: AtomicCandidate) -> None:
    required = {
        "work_task": {"owner", "deadline", "status"},
        "work_method": {"scope", "method_type"},
        "work_artifact": {"artifact_type", "artifact_ref"},
        "work_fact": {"work_object", "status", "activity_start_time", "activity_end_time"},
    }[candidate.type]
    missing = required.difference(candidate.metadata)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"{candidate.type} is missing required metadata: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}")
    if not candidate.content.strip() or len(candidate.content) > 2_000:
        raise ValueError("atomic memory content must be non-empty and bounded")
    lowered = candidate.content.lower()
    if any(marker in lowered for marker in ("private key", "authorization:", "set-cookie:", "password=", "api_key=")):
        raise ValueError("atomic memory contains sensitive material")
    if not 0 <= candidate.confidence <= 1:
        raise ValueError("memory confidence must be between zero and one")
    if candidate.decision not in {"create", "supersede", "merge", "no_op"}:
        raise ValueError("invalid memory conflict decision")
    if candidate.decision in {"supersede", "merge"} and not candidate.supersedes_ids:
        raise ValueError("supersede/merge decisions require replaced memory IDs")
    if candidate.type == "work_method":
        method_lower = candidate.content.lower()
        executable_markers = ("skill.md", "prerequisite", "verification step", "step 1", "1.", "2.")
        if any(marker in method_lower for marker in executable_markers):
            raise ValueError("executable method belongs to SkillStore, not L1 work_method")


def validate_scene_content(content: str) -> None:
    sections = (
        "工作场景",
        "适用条件",
        "核心 SOP",
        "判断逻辑",
        "禁忌与反模式",
        "关键事实依据",
        "相关任务与资产",
        "演化记录",
        "待确认问题",
    )
    if len(content) > 1_500 or any(section not in content for section in sections):
        raise ValueError("invalid work-scene markdown")


def validate_doctrine_content(content: str) -> None:
    sections = (
        "Operating Thesis",
        "Core Principles",
        "Reusable SOPs",
        "Decision Logic",
        "Boundaries & Anti-patterns",
        "Agent Rules",
    )
    forbidden = ("password", "secret", "api key", "TODO", "待办", "blocked", "deadline", "owner")
    if len(content) > 1_200 or any(section not in content for section in sections):
        raise ValueError("invalid operating doctrine markdown")
    if any(token in content.lower() for token in forbidden):
        raise ValueError("operating doctrine contains disallowed transient or sensitive content")
    if re.search(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+==\d", content):
        raise ValueError("operating doctrine contains an unstable exact dependency version")

    ) -> None: ...

    async def read_l2(self, scope: MemoryScope) -> tuple[WorkSceneMemory, ...]: ...

    async def read_all_l2(self) -> tuple[WorkSceneMemory, ...]: ...

    # Read-only browse paths.  Each takes the decoded sort key it continues
    # from and returns one more row than asked for, so the caller can tell

    async def list_l0(
